'''Kenly Maerin''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident in the army led by [[Perrin Aybara]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is short and stocky and has a patchy beard. He shaved his beard but is having another attempt at growing it again.

== Activities ==
He was one of the men to fight [[Trollocs]] when they invaded [[Emond's Field]].

He was in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. 
He accompanies Perrin into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]].

He goes through the aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] before Perrin begins his attack.

He is one of the men who guards Perrin's tent at night.
